intro.text: Sensus Healthcare, Inc. (together, with its subsidiaries, Sensus Medical Devices Ltd. and Sensus Healthcare Services, LLC, unless the context otherwise indicates, “Sensus,” “we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Company”) is a medical device company committed to providing highly effective, non-invasive treatments for non-melanoma skin cancer (NMSC) and post-surgical keloid scar prevention. The Company uses a proprietary low-energy X-ray technology known as superficial radiation therapy (“SRT”), which is based on decades of dedicated research and development, and has successfully incorporated SRT into a portfolio of treatment devices: the SRT-100 TM , SRT-100+ TM and SRT-100 Vision TM . To date, SRT technology has been used to effectively and safely treat oncological and non-oncological skin conditions of close to one-million patients around the world.
